name: LVMH
notes: Revenue = Revenue (Ventes / Chiffre d'affaires). Operating income = 'Operating profit' (Résultat opérationnel, i.e. after other operating income and expenses), not 'Profit from recurring operations'. FY = calendar year. FY2000-2003 French GAAP: 'Résultat opérationnel' there is before 'Autres produits et charges nets', so it is closer in scope to IFRS profit from recurring operations; FY2004+ IFRS (FY2004 IFRS-restated). Several pre-2013 reference documents were retrieved from the BNAINS archive (bnains.org) and the AMF open-data archive (echanges.dila.gouv.fr), not lvmh.com.
